name: notes-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in client; the gateway validates member tokens against it.

dependencies.name: notes-db
dependencies.description: Stores notes: title, body, author, created time and pinned flag.

description: Single backend for Team Notes: lists notes (pinned first, then newest first), returns one note, creates a note with a required title, and pins or unpins a note. Owns the notes table in its dedicated PostgreSQL. Fills the author name from the gateway assertion, never from the request body. Does not implement sign-in, editing, deleting, search or paging.
